summary: VinFast Auto Ltd. furnished a Form 6-K reporting preliminary Q2 2026 global delivery figures, including 70,085 EVs (up 96% YoY) and 286,039 e-scooters/e-bikes. It also noted the late-June 2026 completion of the divestment of its equity interest in VinFast Trading and Production JSC, following an asset split, as part of a move to an asset-light model. This divestiture is disclosed retrospectively and lacks transaction terms, pricing, or structural details. The filing is primarily an operational update; the divestment mention is ancillary and not the focus, with no deal terms provided. As a routine operational report, it does not qualify as a special-situation filing.
